test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (JSO) 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: primary data refers to:

options.text: the firsthand data gathered by the researcher

solution:
The correct answer is **firsthand data gathered by the researcher.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **The firsthand data gathered by the researcher:**

 
 
• Primary data is original data collected directly by the researcher for a specific purpose or project.
 
• In a financial enterprise, this could involve gathering data through surveys, interviews, or experiments to understand customer behavior, market trends, or employee satisfaction.
 
• This data is valuable because it is specific to the researcher's needs and is usually more accurate and relevant to the current study.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Data collected from newspapers:**

 
 
• This is incorrect. Data from newspapers is considered secondary data because it has been collected and published by someone else.
 
• In financial enterprises, newspapers can provide useful insights and data, but this data is not original to the researcher.
 
 
 
• **Information in biographies:**
 
 
• Incorrect. Biographies contain secondary data as they are written based on the information collected by the biographer.
 
• For financial enterprises, biographies might provide historical insights but not original data specific to the current research needs.
 
 
 
• **Data collected by someone else:**
 
 
• This is false. Data collected by someone else is secondary data.
 
• Financial enterprises may use secondary data for market analysis or benchmarking, but it is not primary data.
